extension.summary: A24 Screening Room and AAA24 client for Kodi (in development)
extension.description:
Sign in with your own A24 / AAA24 account and play what that account is entitled to: titles you own or have rented in the A24 Screening Room, the AAA24 member free movie of the month, and filmmaker commentaries and member extras.
IN DEVELOPMENT: the service's endpoints are still being captured; menus that are not built yet say so.
Personal playback only. A24 marks every stream with an on-screen watermark and an invisible forensic watermark tied to the signed-in account. This add-on plays streams exactly as A24 serves them and does nothing to change, hide or remove either watermark.
Rentals and purchases are made in the A24 app or website, never in Kodi. AAA24 membership and the catalogue are US-only.
extension.disclaimer: Unofficial. Not affiliated with or endorsed by A24. Use only with your own account, for your own viewing; streams are watermarked and traceable to that account, and third-party clients may be against the service's terms.
